essence: Offerings are apportioned by the stated range with guru priority.
The rite takes seed from the pot and deposits it in its designated place.
The pādukā is placed outside with an equal, quarter, or half measure.
Consecration is performed by releasing the gem deposit in clockwise order.
The procedure for great pīṭha consecration is now declared.
